titleEnglish: 13 · Yā Nabī Salām ʿAlayka — Mawlid version (Ashraqa-l-kawn)

verses.ar:
يَا نَبِي سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا رَسُولْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا حَبِيبْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
يَا رَسُولَ اللّٰه
صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهْ عَلَيْكَ
verses.tr: Yā Nabī salām ʿalayka · Yā Rasūl salām ʿalayka · Yā Ḥabīb salām ʿalayka · Yā Rasūlallāh · Ṣalawātullāh ʿalayka
verses.en: O Prophet, peace be upon you; O Messenger, peace be upon you; O Beloved, peace be upon you; O Messenger of Allah — the blessings of Allah be upon you.

verses.ar: أَشْرَقَ الْكَوْنُ ابْتِهَاجًا ۞ بِوُجُودِ الْمُصْطَفَى أَحْمَدْ
verses.en: The universe lit up with joy at the coming of the Chosen One, Ahmad.

verses.ar: وَلِأَهْلِ الْكَوْنِ أُنْسٌ ۞ وَسُرُورٌ قَدْ تَجَدَّدْ
verses.tr: Wa li-ahli-l-kawni unsun · wa surūrun qad tajaddad
verses.en: For all who dwell in creation there is intimacy, and a joy made ever new.

verses.ar: فَاطْرَبُوا يَا أَهْلَ الْمَثَانِي ۞ فَهَزَارُ الْيُمْنِ غَرَّدْ
verses.en: So rejoice, O people of the oft-repeated verses — the nightingale of blessedness has burst into song.

verses.ar: وَاسْتَضِيئُوا بِجَمَالٍ ۞ فَاقَ فِي الْحُسْنِ تَفَرَّدْ
verses.en: And seek light from a beauty that surpasses all — unique and unrivaled in loveliness.

verses.ar: وَلَنَا الْبُشْرَى بِسَعْدٍ ۞ مُسْتَمِرٍّ لَيْسَ يَنْفَدْ
verses.tr: Wa lanā-l-bushrā bi-saʿdin · mustamirrin laysa yanfad
verses.en: Ours is the glad tiding of a happiness that continues and never runs out.

verses.ar: حَيْثُ أُوتِينَا عَطَاءً ۞ جَمَعَ الْفَخْرَ الْمُؤَبَّدْ
verses.en: For we were given a gift that gathered everlasting glory within it.

verses.ar: فَلِرَبِّي كُلُّ حَمْدٍ ۞ جَلَّ أَنْ يَحْصُرَهُ الْعَدْ
verses.tr: Fa-li-Rabbī kullu ḥamdin · jalla an yaḥṣurahu-l-ʿadd
verses.en: So to my Lord belongs all praise — too majestic for numbers to contain.

verses.ar: إِذْ حَبَانَا بِوُجُودِ ۞ الْمُصْطَفَى الْهَادِي مُحَمَّدْ
verses.en: For He graced us with the presence of the Chosen One, the Guide — Muhammad.
